visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dyed brownish-orange hair and silver-rimmed glasses sits in a white plastic chair indoors. He wears a black t-shirt with a white 'ATDC' logo on the left chest and a gold ring. He gestures expressively with his hands while speaking. The background features stacks of cardboard boxes, a large air conditioning unit, and a black banner with 'ATDC DREAM CAR' in white text under bright indoor lighting. (2) The scene shifts outdoors where the same man stands beside a white MG SUV under an overcast sky. He holds a car key in his right hand, pointing at the vehicle. Raindrops are visible on the car's hood. The background is a wet parking lot with trees and a black fence. He moves around the car, showcasing its front grille and logo. (3) The man introduces a white Mazda CX-5. He opens the driver-side door, revealing a black interior with red stitching and a red bow decoration on the steering wheel. He points to the digital dashboard displaying '15,000公里' and a 360-degree camera interface on the central screen. The setting remains the same outdoor lot with soft daylight. (4) The host stands in front of a dark grey Ford Focus Wagon. He points at the front grille and then opens the door to show the interior, which features a significantly large vertical central touchscreen. He sits inside the car, gesturing toward the screen and dashboard while raindrops continue to streak the windows. (5) The man squats in front of a matte black Ford Mustang with a distinctive silver cobra emblem on the grille. He points at the hood vents and later shows the rear of the car, highlighting the triple vertical tail lights and quad exhaust pipes. He gestures at the large black wheels with yellow brake calipers. (6) The final phase occurs inside a sleek grey McLaren supercar with its gull-wing doors open upwards. The man sits in the driver's seat, talking to the camera. Later, he stands next to the car in a brightly lit indoor showroom with wavy, decorative light panels on the walls and other luxury vehicles in the blurred background.
